verification.title: Build verification: September 20, 2026
verification.summary: 21 of 21 automated checks pass locally and on Windows, Linux, macOS Intel and macOS Apple silicon runners. All four desktop archives ran a packaged scenario on their own platform; both macOS archives were also run by hand (scenarios, video mode, GUI start). The web app ran a full scenario through the public site with report, CSV and summary downloads. Every PS row, shall item and deliverable re-read against 26169.pdf.
verification.note: Statuses are from runs in the repository, on GitHub Actions runners, and on the project server. Numbers quoted are measured, not estimated. Windows and Linux archives are verified by the runner's tests and packaged smoke test plus archive inspection, not by a hand-driven GUI session on those systems.

checks.name: Automated tests
checks.text: 21 of 21 pytest checks in about 20 s: geometry, gimbal limits, every path on screen and deterministic, centroid accuracy, IMM prediction, closed loop clear, closed loop with vibration, identity under decoys, video path, PS rows 1 to 25 point by point.

checks.name: Scenario pack
checks.text: 11 scenarios, 15 s each. Clear line, circle and figure of 8: 6.7 to 7.3 px mean tracking error at 100% lock. Heavy noise 7.3 px, fog 6.6 px, low light 7.0 px, all 100%. Acquisition 0.6 to 1.4 s everywhere. Hard mode 6.5 to 8.9 px after a 3 to 12 s sweep.

checks.name: Multi-seed envelope
checks.text: 5 seeds per scenario. Clear, noise, fog and low light pass every seed. One of five multi-target stress seeds swapped to a decoy. Platform sway at the PS maximum held 79 to 88% lock.

checks.name: Truth independence
checks.text: The same random-motion run twice, the second time with ground truth deleted before the tracker: 0.000000 px difference in estimates and 0 px in the camera path over 240 frames. The tracker sees only the picture.

checks.name: Benchmark 2 path
checks.text: A synthetic 1200 x 1200 mp4 through the video input: 180 frames, lock 100%, CSV and PDF written. A 60 fps phone video tracked 669 of 754 frames with the 5 deg/s gimbal saturated 60% of the time.

checks.name: Standalone executable
checks.text: Four native archives from one workflow: Windows x64, Linux x64 (Ubuntu 22.04 glibc), macOS Intel, macOS Apple silicon. Each job ran the 21 tests, the web smoke test and the packaged executable on a scenario. Apple silicon archive by hand: clear line 233 FPS, full stress 109 FPS, video mode 190 FPS, GUI alive after 12 s. Intel archive under Rosetta 2: 176, 115, 119 FPS, GUI alive. Windows and Linux archives inspected: both executables, configs, model, manual present.

checks.name: AI detector
checks.text: v2 reaches 8 px validation localisation, supplied 51% of measurements on the phone video, does not acquire the faint SNR 3 beacon. Kept as a gap-filling fallback; classical carries the load.

checks.name: Platform at PS maximum
checks.text: 20 px per frame sway plus 20 px per frame vibration: 83% lock. The gimbal is at 90% of its slew budget. A physical limit of the mandated 5 deg/s motor, documented rather than tuned away.

checks.name: Demo video
checks.text: Optional in the PS. Not produced; the web app lets an evaluator run every scenario live instead. Technical report (14 pages) and user manual are exported to PDF and on the site.

checks.name: Web app on the server
checks.text: Same engine served by FastAPI behind Caddy on a 4-core ARM server: clear line 123 FPS, full stress 59 FPS there. A noisy-line run through the public site in a real browser locked at 1.43 s, 68 FPS, 5 of 5 specification checks, report and CSV downloaded. One run at a time, any number of viewers, reconnect on socket drop.

checks.name: PS re-read
checks.text: 26169.pdf re-read on September 20: rows 1 to 25, the eight shall items, five deliverables, four evaluation stages. All mandatory items implemented and tested. Optional items: colour camera, multiple targets, spiral, sinusoidal and user-defined (waypoint) paths, all disturbance kinds. Only the optional demo video is not produced.
